opening.argument: The speaker presents BitConnect as an accessible, deposit-like opportunity for ordinary people, calling it one of his favorites because it is something a layperson can do. He claims participants are receiving almost 1% interest per day on their money and directs viewers toward participation through a BitConnect referral link. Although he briefly acknowledges risk, he describes having approximately $19,000 there and closes by saying it is a great time to get in. Those features make the communication an endorsement of the lending opportunity, not a warning about it.
